name: A Little Beauty

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you can gather vibrant hippogryph down to adorn your hair with soft plumes. This custom brings small joys to Zephras through hardship.

faq.answer: The Skyborne gather wild hippogryph down to make hair adornments. The vibrant, silky soft plumes have fallen from the birds, which can trouble travelers near the settlement.
faq.q: Why are hippogryph feathers being collected?

faq.answer: Zephras is the island home of the Skyborne. Its artisan crafts hair adornments from gathered feathers to bring happiness and lighthearted moments to residents.
Wild hippogryphs nest southwest of the village in the Shen'dar Highlands. They are territorial and keep unwanted guests away from their nesting grounds.
The artisan believes small joys and beauty matter, especially in difficult times. Bringing happiness to others makes the effort worthwhile.
faq.q: Why are small luxuries like hair adornments important in times like these?

faq.answer: The wild hippogryphs southwest of the village defend their nesting grounds from intruders. Gathering their fallen feathers can be hazardous for unwary travelers.
faq.q: Are the hippogryphs hostile to visitors?

faq.answer: Yes, many Skyborne weave vibrant plumes into their hair. Hippogryph down is exceptionally soft and well suited to these adornments.
faq.q: Is decorating hair with feathers common among the Skyborne?

sections.body: Wild hippogryphs nest on Zephras Isle, southwest of the village in the Shen'dar Highlands. They are territorial and can trouble travelers nearby. Yet they shed vibrant, silky soft down, which the Skyborne gather to weave into hair ornaments.
sections.title: Plumes of the Highlands

sections.body: For Zephras's artisan, gathering feathers for hair is more than vanity. Even in hard times, small joys shared with others help keep the community's spirit alive. Beauty gives each day in the village something to celebrate.
sections.title: Finding Joy in Small Things

summary: In the Shen'dar Highlands, the Skyborne gather hippogryph down near Zephras. Its bright plumes bring beauty and small joys to the village through hard times.
